verdicts.reason: Confirmed: the query construction on line 42 uses f-string interpolation of request.args['user_id'] directly into the SQL string. Classic injection vector.
The range is intentionally exclusive of the last element per the slice convention in this codebase; the docstring on line 12 specifies exclusive upper bound.
Agreed: 3600 appears 4 times in the file; extracting to SESSION_DURATION_SECONDS would improve readability.
The nested loop is necessary here because the inner list is modified during iteration; a set lookup would cause incorrect skip behavior.

new_findings.title: Hardcoded JWT secret key
new_findings.rationale: The JWT secret is hardcoded as a string literal 'super-secret-key-123' which will be committed to version control and expose the application to token forgery attacks.

new_findings.title: Unhandled None return from parse_record()
new_findings.rationale: parse_record() can return None for malformed input (see its docstring), but the caller on line 22 calls .get() on the result without a null check, causing AttributeError at runtime.
